verdict.rationale: ADK's docs publish a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 document titled "ADK REST API Reference" for the ADK API server. It is generated at docs build time from the FastAPI app and linked from the API Reference index, and a Swagger UI is served at /docs by the Python and TypeScript API servers. The probe 404s were at the google.github.io root, not the adk.dev path where the spec is published, so they do not contradict it. Missing for 10: prose documentation of the running server's own /openapi.json endpoint, spec/Swagger parity for the Go API server, independent or hands-on corroboration of the downloaded spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: ADK publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 document (info title "ADK REST API Reference") for the ADK API server, extracted at docs build time from the FastAPI app and linked from the docs' API Reference index.
The docs site additionally hosts a Swagger UI browsing the published spec.
